_purpose: Per-view prompts for A1's eight twin cameras (yaw 0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315), versioned. Consumed by restylize_views.py --prompts and, through profiles/a1.json's _fixtures.twin_prompts.path, checked by tools/diagnostics/e12_pair_cloud_step.py's pre-flight (provenance check (b): --prompts IS this file, unmodified). Keys are INPUT STEMS matching facet_E58/controls/clay/a1clay_{0..7}.png.
_rule_deviation_disclosed: W3/dragon precedent (E02-prompts.json's own rule, restated in E08-twin-prompts.json: 'describe what THAT camera can see and omit what it cannot... a rear camera is never told about a beard') is NOT followed here. E58's charter Stage D text asks the twin prompt to carry EVERY ratified occupant phrase, the framing clause, the style clauses, and the four staging clauses -- not a per-view-visible subset. All eight views below carry the IDENTICAL 18-phrase string. This is a disclosed, literal reading of the charter's instruction, not an oversight of the per-view law: no per-view drop-list (which face/hand phrases a rear view cannot see) was authored this arc. Flagged for a future ruling on whether A1 should adopt the W3/dragon per-view-drop convention once a ring exists to look at.
_composed_from: The 18 ratified phrases in canon/a1.surfaces.json: 10 NAMED (N1-N10, canon/A1-IDENTITY.md) + 1 framing clause (frame_subject) + 3 style clauses (style_paint, style_palette, style_face) + 4 staging clauses (stage_bg, stage_no_weapons, stage_no_held, stage_clear_sil), joined as a comma-separated list of noun phrases -- the SAME convention already proven for the dragon/beast (profiles/beast.json prompt, E12 Ruling 9c: 'every element its own noun phrase'), not a copy of canon/A1-RECIPE.json's raw prose. Verified against the live canon_gate.check_prompt() BEFORE this file was written (facet_E58/stageB/test_stageD_prompt.py): ok=True, missing=[], forbidden=[], unlicensed=[]. The reference's own raw positive_text does NOT pass this check (unlicensed residue: the pose/lighting staging sentence that canon/A1-IDENTITY.md itself names 'generation staging, not identity' and that was deliberately never promoted to a ratified legal_clause) -- see docs/experiments/E58-a1-twin-ring-report.md Stage B section.
